description: Agile-X gate array placement metadata for base.gds (8 signal pins × 6 Y terminals + VDD/VSS buses + global routing)

globalRouting.notes: VDD/VSS buses span each cell row at vddBusY/vssBusY (including X>=5700). Cross-row and I/O nets must use rowCrossingY (5/145) terminals. At jumperPinX columns, Y=5 and Y=145 are vertically connected via lower metal and may be used as jumpers. I/O routing: grid A* for X<ioBoundaryXUm, then off-grid Manhattan to pads.
